about_the_game:
About This Demo
The Chief Cenab: Şahmaran Demo lets you experience the opening chapters of the full game. This version includes three playable chapters:

  • Office – The chapter set in the office during the evening.

  • Parking Lot – A quiet but dangerous pursuit in the dead of night.

  • Factory – Clues hidden in the shadows of an abandoned building.

In these chapters, you will engage in interactive dialogues with characters, solve environmental puzzles, and collect clues to uncover the core story. The game is presented in a unique black-and-white comic book style with selective color highlights for key elements.

The demo also includes basic control mechanics, object interactions, and the puzzle-solving experience, allowing you to get a feel for the game’s atmosphere and gameplay before the full release.

This demo contains only the beginning of the story and core gameplay mechanics. The full game will feature additional chapters, new locations, characters, and puzzles.

short_description: Step into Chief Cenab’s shoes and unravel the legend of Şahmaran. Told through striking black-and-white comic panels, this point and click demo lets you explore mysterious events and immerse yourself in a deep, atmospheric world.
